description: This file is a C header file containing declarations and macros for secure system call wrappers, including functions like v_secure_system, v_secure_popen, and related macros and constants, used for secure command execution and validation.

methods.name: v_secure_system
methods.description: Wrapper for system() that enforces compile-time format string checks and replaces system calls with secure variants.

methods.name: v_secure_popen
methods.description: Wrapper for popen() that enforces compile-time checks on direction and command format.

methods.name: v_secure_pclose
methods.description: Closes a FILE pointer opened by v_secure_popen.

methods.name: contains_secure_separator
methods.description: Obsolete inline function that always returns 0.

methods.name: secure_system_call_p
methods.description: External function for secure system call with argument vector.

methods.name: secure_system_call_vp
methods.description: External variadic function for secure system call.
